request.creator: jdoe
request.description: - Update to 2.10.4 * Fixed a buffer overflow in `Mangle()` where the caller's buffer could be overrun * Fixed `Reverse()` stepping before the start of its buffer * Fixed `Pluralise()` reading `string[-1]` for an empty string * Fixed negative char values reaching `ctype` functions * Added support for building on GNU/Hurd (`portable_endian.h` adapted) * Various Python improvements * Updated translations * Autotools build fixes and cleanups - Refresh 0002-cracklib-2.9.2-visibility.patch - Build the dict-small subpackage as noarch, since it ships only architecture-independent dictionary data
